definitions: A person whom one knows and with whom one has a bond of mutual affection, typically exclusive of sexual or family relations.
A person who acts as a supporter or patron.
A person who is not an enemy or who is on the same side.
A person with whom one is acquainted.
examples: He's a friend of the family.
They remained friends despite the argument.
Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
